text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain approves projects requiring total investment of 20 million dinars when implemented.
- Bahrain training facilities to be marketed globally.
- Bahrain and United Arab Emirates in plan to boost jobs market.
- National Bank of Bahrain awarded $520 million loan mandate for power and water plant.
- Bahrain Aluminium Extrusion Company (BALEXCO) expects good 1996 profit.
- Bahrain's Taib bank net profit jumps 7.5 percent to $10.4 million.
- Bahrain spends around $106 million on training annually.
